'''Corridor G147''', also known as '''sector G147''', was an area of space within the [[Roche asteroid field]] in the [[Roche system]]. During the [[blockade of the Roche system]], corridor G147 was guarded by a single [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] intended to use corridor G147 as an escape route from the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] for the [[Verpine fleet]] and prototype [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighters]]. Following the destruction of [[Research Station Shantipole]], Ackbar was forced to lead the unarmed Verpine fleet into a one-sided battle against the escort frigate until the arrival of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]]s flying the prototype B-wing starfighters. The new starfighters managed to disable the vessel and allow the Verpine fleet to escape.<ref name="SFS" />
